final: SELECT s.zoneref, st.riskeval, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans AS s2 JOIN sites AS st2 ON st2.zoneregistry = s2.zoneref GROUP BY s2.zoneref, st2.riskeval) AS proportion FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.riskeval ORDER BY proportion DESC LIMIT 10
